chapters.label: Live: the 2010 UEFA Futsal Cup final
chapters.text: Lisbon, 2010, the UEFA Futsal Cup final. Benfica are one down. Big Joel is fouled at the edge of the box. Ricardinho rolls it short, and Joel blasts it in! One all!

chapters.label: Replay: short pass, quick hit
chapters.text: Watch again: one short pass, one quick hit. Benfica won in extra time, and Joel was top scorer!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His trademark is the toe-poke. This is how he does it: the defender rushes in, no time to swing, so he jabs it with his toes. Goal!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Your turn: no time to swing? Use a toe-poke and shoot fast!
